notes.title: 【端午安康・江湖同慶】
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43341309/cbc4f834616971b9f666386ddaabf74bba3d3c5a.jpg[/img]

粽葉飄香，艾草掛門，江湖兒女也要過節！
今朝端午，不論你在江湖哪個角落，是在練功打怪、還是跑腿送信，都別忘了好好吃口粽子、掛束香艾，保佑平安！

傳說中，綠綠的艾草能延命避邪；青綠如劍的鋒芒之中，也藏著對彼此的守護。
那手腕上繫著的五色絲線，正是「長命縷」，
象徵五行齊聚、鎮毒納福，是江湖人給親友最直接的祝福。

祝各位俠士：
行俠路上無煩憂，
糯香入夢樂無邊，
端午安康，粽橫四方！

notes.title: Traveler of Wuxia English Version Announce
notes.notes:
[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/43341309/24ba83772298a00e8046def4d131b8446f2d9d64.png[/img]

Hello everyone:

We’re happy to announce that Traveler of Wuxia is finally getting its English version on Steam!
After a long translation and proofreading process, we are excitedly looking forward to bringing the English version to more players, inviting them to join Little Shrimp on an adventure in the world of Heluo. Together, let's experience the Eastern Wuxia fantasy world!

If you come across any translation errors or inaccuracies, please feel free to provide feedback and suggestions in the Steam Discussion forum at any time!

notes.title: 《天外武林》上市公告
notes.notes:
各位玩家們好，工作室的最新作品《天外武林》將於本週五1月6日上午8時於Steam平台正式上市，售價預計定為新台幣358元，上市後首週將開啟九折優惠。
此外也將同步推出與前作《河洛群俠傳》綑綁的九折優惠組合包。

[img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/43341309/503348188dc4da521166f5f0e4a1a082e3ed17be.png[/img]

跟隨少年小小米穿越至廣大的江湖世界，身負重任的他，必須找回失落的四枚聖物，否則天下蒼生將面對滅頂之災。
與同伴相逢、做出決斷，經過一次次的旅程，少年究竟能否找回聖物，阻止背後的陰謀？
天下武學何其多，又該如何精修武藝，以達到天下第一的境界？
踏入《天外武林》，尋找一切的解答吧！

[img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/43341309/02740acb9a554b49836ca3fca4b14ffcf098499b.gif[/img]
[img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/43341309/080a7efcb766548b3d4280031e1f47484beb4b3f.gif[/img]
[img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/43341309/9d2173c4e50ebce417b5af74248d84bb97090823.gif[/img]
[img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/43341309/82c45544e510ced0691bcc174e243972b1dd1fa2.gif[/img]

歡迎各位玩家在作品上市後給予開發團隊更多反饋與指教！工作室也會繼續努力為玩家們帶來更多有趣的內容，謝謝大家長久以來的支持與愛護！
